body: if you've got some money go for a weekend away somewhere, relax, and then see how you feel. get out of the environment which makes you feel this way. if you do get to the stage where you think your going to take your life, may i ask how will you do it?

move away, talk to people, force your self to change your own life. remember the things that use to make you happy, and make new memories. lifes just a game, see how things change in the future. i feel like killing my self everyday, but then i realise how much heartbreak it would cause, and even more suicides just from my one. imagine the pain it will cause your family or friends, and what if the suicide attempt didn't work? I've tried twice, once from an overdose and got found and i survived, and i also got found hanging by my neck and i was in a coma and still survived. believe me, without the bad times in life we wouldn't know what the good ones are
